svg.text: Three LED chains from the Teensy through one level shifter to the segments, built twice
R4 to R6 each rated 0.25 W
R1 to R3 at the inputs
Pin 12 to GND, pin 11 stays unconnected
Two boards, the same parts and wiring
R1 to R3 at their buffer inputs
the edge calculation counts only short wiring at each input
the loop from the supply pin through the capacitor stays short
C2 carries each step of the LED current where the feed arrives
